svg.title: Tools and experience
svg.desc: Four areas of Manuel's daily development work. The tools behind it. At work, at home, behind the scenes. At work PHP · Vue · MySQL Business interfaces, APIs and data synchronisation. Application development at zvoove since 2021. Making sure it works Cypress · E2E testing Around 30 substantial release tests, execution and failure analysis. Playwright migration in progress. My own products React · TypeScript · tRPC Built with AI support. I own the ideas, design and ongoing operation, alongside my PHP/Vue background. Keeping them running Linux · nginx · Docker My rented root server, my configurations. Codex, Claude Code and custom skills in the daily workflow.
